notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 1.0.1 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]1.0.1 Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]A new improved weapons selection screen that displays more detailed information about weapons. It has new accuracy, hipfire, stability and mobility scores and bars that are calculated from exact values making it easier to compare weapons. Also critical hit chances and reload times are also shown now.   
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added two new submachine guns: M635 and P90
[*]Reduced bullet spread by 10% for all weapons (players only).
[*]Minor adjustments here and there in weapon stats.
[*]Removed light machine guns shooting while moving accuracy penalty.
[/list]
[h3]AI team:[/h3]
[list]
[*]AI teammates are now better at reviving downed characters that end into tricky places while in ragdoll.
[/list]
[h3]Misc fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to crash occasionally. This happened usually in Tower mission's top floors, but the crash cause wasn't specially related for this place, so crashing could also occur in other missions too.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the health and armor bars turn grey (risk of insta death) even downed just once. This could happen only if downed while Bishop's Inspire ability was active. Also AI teammates were affected by this.
[*]Wave defense missions' bomb timers are now correctly halted during the game is paused (single player only) while the Team Command Screen is visible.
[*]Characters that get stuck in objects after revived are now teleported back to a good location. 
[*]Fixed an issue of invisible enemies sometimes quickly flash ghosted in red when the player went up a floor level inside a building.
[*]Closed doors should now block line of sight more reliable, so less likely to see enemies through small gaps between doors and frames.
[*]Fixed knife throwing animation glitching that occurred if a small weapon like Mini Uzi or M10 was equipped. 
[*]Fixed an issue that caused the player to be unable to interact with items on ground if the crosshair was over an AI teammate.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the host player's aiming down sights animation was not always correctly replicated to client players.
[*]Fixed an issue that caused players to have their weapons positioned a bit off from hands sometimes.  
[*]Added camera shake for melee attacks.
[*]Vehicles and large gasoline containers are now immune to melee damage...
[*]Fixed short weapons' flashlights positions so they cannot light through closed doors when near.   
[*]Fixed a bug that caused damaged enemies health bars to be hidden in certain situations even enemies were visible. 
[*]Fixed couple things that appeared too reddish in Night Vision mode, like Laser Trip Mines' beam.
[*]Mission End Screen exp/money counter sounds are now stopped instantly when End Mission or Retry Mission buttons clicked. 
[*]Some additional minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 1.0 Full Release - Leaving Early Access
notes.content:
[h2]Version 1.0 Out Now![/h2]

Hey, I'm excited to finally announce that version 1.0 is out. It took a bit longer than intended to get to this point... On the other hand, a lot more content was added than initially planned. Thank you all who purchased the game during Early Access, despite the early versions being pretty limited content-wise. Also thanks for bug reporting, ideas, and support. If you have enjoyed the game, now would be a good time to recommend it to friends!

[h2]1.0 Patch Notes:[/h2]
This update mainly focuses on fixing the last known bugs and issues that were in the 1.0 pre-release.


[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added red warning icons for dangerously close frag grenades and flashbangs to make them easier to spot.
[/list]
[h3]Visual improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Heavy Load mission: Some decorative work on the cargo ship deck like added some mooring ropes.
[/list]
[h3]Misc fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Multiplayer spectator mode should be now a bit smoother and overall less bugging. Also the night vision toggle is now working in the spectator mode.  
[*]Fixed a bug in Gamepad Aim Assist that caused some serious camera glitching issues when ADS aiming enemies on near screen bottom edge. 
[*]The camera is now centered to the player character when downed. 
[*]Fixed an issue causing that damaged enemies health bars were not visible when enemies were inside a building but on another floor than the player character. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused host players in multiplayer spectator mode to emit their aura bonuses as if they were still alive and in the same spot as the player they were spectating. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Gamepad Aim Assist to track fire extinguishers flying in the air after they were shot and exploded by the player.
[*]Prison Break mission: Fixed a bug that caused a part of 2nd floor wall sometimes randomly be missing in the center section of the prison (cafeteria). This bug may have also occurred in couple other missions too that has double-height indoor areas, so it should now be fixed in those as well. 
[*]Prison Break mission: Potentially fixed a bug that caused enemies have a small chance to just stand still instead of attacking the evac zone in the final defend against remaining enemies objective. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused AI teammates sometimes move a first aid kit back and forth each other without anyone using it. This happened only if they both were downed 2 times after the last time of using a first aid kit.
[*]Potentially fixed a bug that caused dead enemy ragdolls sometimes freeze in the air. 
[*]Firing with a fully automatic weapon starts now after vaulting if the fire button was pressed down while vaulting, without the need to release and press the button again.
[*]Firing with a fully automatic weapons stops now if the player jumps down and is in the air (continues when recovered from landing and if the fire button is still held down).
[*]Adjusted FAMAS G2 position when carried on back of a character (was weirdly positioned because it's the only bullpup in the game)
[*]Fixed an issue that caused some "Press key to do something" key infos were shown through the level map and the skill tree.
[/list]

notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 1.0 Pre-Release Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]1.0 Pre-Release Update Patch Notes[/h2]

This update adds a new Merciless difficulty level that offers a decent challenge for maxed out characters. Also fixes a bug that caused the lower difficulty levels to be much harder than originally intended, so the game should be a bit less brutal for new players.

The game is now pretty close to 1.0 final release. The next update is coming when leaving Early Access in July. I will set the launch date when I have the new trailer ready. 

[h3]Difficulty: [/h3]
[list]
[*]Added a new Merciless difficulty. Should offer a decent challenge for players with maxed out characters. 
[*]Added a new achievement for completing the new difficulty level. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies to shoot too accurately in most situations. This made especially lower difficulty levels much harder than originally in early versions. 
[*]Added some additional bullet spread when enemies try to shoot moving targets.    
[*]Added mission failed exp reward up to 50% of completed exp. Based on how many enemies killed of total. 
[*]Friendly fire is now: easy 25%, normal 33% and 50% for all harder difficulties.
[/list]
[h3]Characters' Skills/Abilities:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Dexter's Explosives Awareness ability renamed to Danger Awareness. It also gives now 5% increased change to dodge. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Dexter Booby Trap sometimes deal lower damage than it should or no damage at all.
[*]Boody Trap also stuns enemies for 3.5 seconds. 
[*]Totally changed Razor's Spotter ability. It gives now additional 5% critical hit chance for all team members (including self) who shoot enemies that Razor has line of sight. 
[*]Bishop's Leading by Example was giving also +10% to melee and knife damage, even not mentioned in ability description -> REMOVED. 
[*]Enemy turrets captured with Jinx's Hacking ability have now 2x health boost instead of 1.5x. 
[*] Explosives skill gives now +3% to radius per skill level instead of 5%. Max 15% instead of 25%.
[/list]
[h3]AI teammates:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added critical hit chance to AI teammates' weapons (~3% boost to overall damage).
[*]AI teammates will no longer crouch while the player is crouched if they need to avoid grenades or other hazards.
[*]AI Teammates are now getting into full cover when armor is low and staying there until armor regenerated back to full. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused AI teammates sometimes have -1 First Aid Kits, and after that they were unable to pick and use First Aid Kits at all.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused AI teammates sometimes try to shoot through objects that can't be shot through.
[/list]
[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused armor points of elite enemies not regenerate past 100 armor points on higher difficulties.
[*]Difficulty levels now affect the armor regeneration rate of elite enemies.
[*]Enemies now take more damage to armor durability when hit (armor durability = point that armor regenerates back to if they are not killed). 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemy bullet tracers to not go through characters that dodged bullets with dodge skill. Also smokes were blocking enemy bullet tracers.
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Additional damage caused by a weapon's Armor Piercing trait is now applied only against armor points of an armored enemy. 
[*]Grenades and other explosives have now armor penetration so they are more useful against elite enemies on harder difficulties. 
[*]Extra Armor Piercing damage is not shown when Show Damage Numbers enabled. 
[*]Added critical hit chance to melee strikes and throwing knives. Surprise attack is considered as auto 2x crit. AI teammates can also crit with melee. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused throwing knives deal less damage if recently run out of stamina while melee attacking (even after stamina was restored back to full).
[*]A successful dodge against a enemy's shotgun shot dodges now all pellets of the shot or none. 
[*]Reduced molotov fire area radius from 4 to 3.6 meters.
[/list]
[h3]Animations[/h3]
[list]
[*]M10 submachine gun uses now same animations as Mini Uzi instead pistol ones (player only).
[/list]
[h3]Menus:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Mission End Screen has now increasing counters and progress bars with sound effects for exp and money.
[/list]
[h3]Visual improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Night Vision is now better turning things to greenish tint. There were some items and effects that had yellow, blue or red tint even Night Vision was on.
[/list]
[h3]Misc fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added unspent skill points message showing in lobby menu chat if the player has available skill points (not shown when playing with gamepad). 
[*]Fixed a bug that disabled sniper rifles' auto crit feature if the player stood near a interactable door. Also gamepad aim assist didn't work in same situation. 
[*]Potentially fixed a bug that caused molotov flames textures to be blurry when first time loaded. 
[*]All ammo crates that had 2000 ammo points reduced to 1000 ammo points. 
[*]Potentially fixed a bug that caused enemies to plant two bombs to exact same spot in wave defense missions.
[*]Villa mission is renamed to Villa Vibes. 
[*]Esc can be used to close skill tree without opening main menu in same press (when in mission, not in lobby map). 
[*]Some additional minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 1.0 Pre-Release Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]1.0 Pre-Release Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]Visual improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]New pretty nice looking grass that uses meshes instead of old plain flat grass material. Smoothly culled away when looking down from building tops. Some performance hit is expected with potato GPUs when lots of grass on screen. If the performance hit is too much, use Foliage Quality setting in the options menu to lower grass density and wheat field density in Unholy Alliance mission.
[*]New HUGELY better looking water shader that has adjusted looks for diffent water types, so rivers, swimming pools, oceans, lakes, large fountains etc. looks a bit different. Water waves direction and heights are affected by wind. Also added water caustics effect for swimming pools and large fountains.
[*]Cliffs looks much better now. Using meshes instead of just rock texture painted on landscape. In addition new rock material is better looking with some moss on top of rocks.
[*]Lots of decorative work in key buildings and locations. Loads of new props to make the game look less boring. New pillars, curtains, destroyable vases, fireplaces with fire, flagpole with a flag waving in the wind (Turdavia has a flag now!), doors, solar panels, signs, posters, food items, misc small items, barbed wires, tank hedgehogs etc. 
[*]Added some stuff especially to improve the atmosphere of night missions, like neon signs, helipad landing lights, campfires and barrel fires. 
[/list]
[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Exploding cars. All vehicles take damage and starts smoking when lightly damaged. Severely damaged vehicles starts burning and explodes after a timer runs out. Grenades and RPGs can blow vehicles instantly. Also heavy sniper instantly blows vehicles on critical hits. In addition to vehicles the large gasoline tank is explodable.
[*]The player has now a 50% chance to die instantly without a possibility to be revived, when gets downed third time in a row without using First Aid Kit. The health/armor bars turns to grey when there is a chance to die instantly. Also white mist is shown on screen edges for a while to warn the player that the next time may be fatal. After being revived, there is a 5s safe time during which insta death chance is ignored. Also AI teammates can die instantly, so you see them using First Aid Kits. This means they are less likely to give their First Aid Kits to the player. 
[*]Circular directional hit indicator that shows directions from which the player was damaged. Indicator's scale and visibility is slighly altered based on damage strenght. This can be disabled in the options menu.
[*]Added camera shake effects for weapon recoil, taking damage and explosions. The effect is scaled based on how powerful weapon you shoot, how much damage you take etc. Can be turned off in the options menu.
[*]The health bar is now animated (pulsing at "heart rate") and heartbeat sound is played when on low health. Pumping faster based on how much health is below 50. The sound can be disabled in the options menu.
[*]When shooting characters, bullet impact effect and sound is now different if damage is fully blocked by body armor.
[*]Improved visibility (camera movement) to screen bottom direction. Camera moves ~2 meters more when ADS and ~1 meters more when not.
[*]It's now a little bit darker inside buildings when lights are disabled (doesn't affect Night Vision). Below ground level floors gets even more darker.
[/list]
[h3]Menus:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added two new background scenes that are displayed in the main menu randomly. 
[*]Added three new background images for map loading screen to randomize from.
[*]Difficulty settings is now saved to savefile. 
[*]Lots of stuff were applied (to game instance not savefile) in the options menu even not pressing apply btn. Applied now only when btn is pressed.
[*]Reduced difficulty setting text size in mission desc -> long mission names + very hard difficulty should not crop text anymore.
[*]Weapons Selector should now scroll currently selected weapon into view when opened.
[*]Weapons Selector shows currently selected weapon's stat when the cursor hovers out of widget (instead lastly hovered weapon's, can be used to compare weapons)
[/list]
[h3]AI improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused AI teammates potentially go to upper floor if move commanded them by clicking on wall instead floor.
[*]Fixed an issue in Pause TM Command that caused AI teammates not move at all if set move location over some small item like a table or a crate. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused molotov flames scare teammates who are on another floor.
[*]AI characters can now start shooting through certain interior windows that has intact glass (not exterior wall windows).
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Weapon reload button works now even the player is shooting.
[*]Characters ignited to flames by molotovs has an increased chance to flames go out faster after leaving molotov flame area. This also means that you see more enemies survive from molotovs.
[*]Molotov flames and characters ignited to flames receive damage 0.5s intervals instead of 1.0s (DPS still same). 
[*]Fixed an issue that flames on characters ignited by molotovs were not correctly sync in multiplayer for clients (enemies in flames even the flames were already gone out in host side).
[*]Using First Aid Kit removes burning damage effects on character.
[*]Exploding fire extinguishers puts out flames from burning characters who are inside radius.
[/list]
[h3]Sounds:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused footstep sounds not play when a character moves inside smoke.
[*]Heavy Load: Added creaking ship structure sounds when inside the cargo ship.
[/list]
[h3]Animations:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused vault animation not playing if melee striking just before.
[/list]
[h3]Misc fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Increased Chemlight's collision size -> should be less likely to fall through floor and disappear.
[*]TeamCommandArrow is now hidden when downed -> should fix a bug that it stays visible over spectator's ghost if died while the arrow was visible.
[*]Endgame: Fixed a bug that caused dead enemies' ragdolls potentially bug in Parliament Building in corridors that has marble tiles.  
[*]Named all reach level achievements.
[*]Weapon QualityLevel is clamped to max 10 (prevents potential save game edit cheating).
[*]All skill levels are clamped to max 5 (prevents potential save game edit cheating).
[*]Accepting Steam invite checks now that the player has entered name -> without name (and savefile) cannot be sucked to multiplayer game through Steam invite (potentially caused some issues).
[*]Increased inventory item list size -> shows gas cans in Dexter's inventory
[*]Explodable barrels leaves now burn marks to ground and walls.
[*]Fixed chat widget visibility issues in mission end screen.
[*]Chat widget can be now closed also by pressing ESC.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused mouse cursor disappear after using chat widget in Pause TM Command.
[*]Some additional minor fixes and improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 0.9.9 hotfix
notes.content:
Unfortunately 0.9.9 introduced a couple of pretty nasty bugs that needed to fixed instantly. Also fixed some other less severe issues, that may be older or also came in the last update.

[h2]0.9.9 hotfix notes[/h2]
[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug that caused sleeping enemies in night missions to have a high probability to fell out of bed so badly they fell out of the map. This caused bugging in "clear all enemies in the area" -type objectives, since they just disappeared. So, there was a high chance that the player could not finish the mission. Warehouse Wars was one of them.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused some issues in the keybindings if using other than default keybindings.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused the game crash when commanded Ai team to assault through a certain door(s). Found one, not sure if there were more of them, but all other similar issues should be fixed now.
[*]Pausing the game pauses now also the smoke mortar bomb spawner in Warehouse Wars. 
[*]Fixed bugging in the Molotov flames that caused them sometimes be hidden even should be visible. 
[*]Fixed the smoke grenade to release smoke only when the grenade is on ground and not moving. Also fixed some visibility issues. 
[*]Fixed a bug that caused Dexter's C4 icon and text missing in the game controller item selection wheel. It was still possible to select C4:s from the empty slot. 
[/list]

notes.title: Blacklist Brigade - Version 0.8.2 - Patch Notes!
notes.content:
Hey, this update contains some pretty big changes to the gameplay. The biggest one is that you cannot see enemies through walls anymore if no one on your team has a line of sight. The game can be a bit more challenging now but the difference should not be too huge. This can potentially have some bugs, so please let me know if you find some weird stuff bothering your gameplay experience. I have also been working for a new mission, so the next update is planned to be that one.

[h2]0.8.2 Patch Notes[/h2]
[h3]New features:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enemies (and civilians) are now visible only when the player character or an another team member has a line of sight to them. They are dissolved back to invisible if no one has a los within 3 seconds. Added an appear/dissolve effect to make enemies turning to visible a bit easier to spot.
[*]Enemies and Teammates are now MUCH better using covers. Staying crouched when taking too much damage or being clearly outnumbered etc. Enemies can also go to a cover pre-emptive when hearing weapon noises. 50% of enemies are randomized to be able to use covers. 
[*]Elite enemies with body armors (regenerating armor bars), better quality level weapons, and suppressors sometimes. ~20% (affected by difficulty level) portion of regular enemies are randomly promoted to elites, so they are not always at exactly same locations. Regular enemies who doesn't have the armor bar cannot drop armor pickups anymore.
[/list]
[h3]New weapons and adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Added two new weapons, RPK light machine gun, and AKSU-74 assault rifle.
[*]Heavy weapons are now divided into Heavy I and Heavy II categories. Heavy I gives half less mobility penalties than Heavy II. AA-12 and RPK are Heavy I, other Heavy weapons are Heavy II.
[*]Sniper rifles deal +50% damage to enemies with body armors.  
[/list]
[h3]Fixes and improvements:[/h3]
[list]
[*]Improvements to Ai Teammates logic how they select the best target to shoot -> a little boost to Teammates performance.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused camera movement being inverted in some cases while climbing ladders.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a civilian hostage following the player, potentially get stuck and stop following after exiting a ladder.  
[*]Enemies not visible to camera but in the line of sight to the player character are now rendered in red (parts that are hidden to the player) instead of red outlines. Also made this effect to be triggered more often.
[*]Fixed a bug causing incorrect bullet spread sometimes while auto firing and simultaneously switching Aim Down Sights on/off.
[*]Teammates should now stay closer to the location where individually commanded to move.
[*]Teammates aggressive range to chase enemies is reduced also while the player is behind a cover.
[*]Teammates following the player prefers now locations near to cover objects.
[*]Armor drops are now less RNG (it was possible to get no drops for entire mission if really unlucky, especially on harder difficulties). 
[*]Enemies are given +10% to attack range in some situations, like when shooting back to the player who dealt damage to them.
[*]Suppressors are now visible on weapon pickups.
[*]Weapon pickups with upgraded weapon quality levels are now color coded while holding down ALT to see items on ground.
[*]Swap an equipped weapon to a weapon on ground -widget shows now weapon images, quality levels etc. instead of plain text.
[*]Prison Break: Added a couple computers to help to locate the prisoners.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies sometimes keep shooting the player even the player is downed.
[*]Auto turrets have now reduced attack range while attacking the player from screen bottom direction.
[*]Dexter's Explosives Awareness gives now also 33% reduction to flashbang duration.
[*]Fixed a bug that caused a throwing knife not be retrievable when thrown to a sleeping enemy equipped with a melee weapon.
[*]Teammates are no longer spawned into Lobby Map if a client player leaves a multiplayer game.
[*]+ Fixed some additional minor or cosmetic "issues".
[/list]

[*]Fixed a bug that caused enemies potentially drop their stuff to the another side of the wall.

[*] + Some additional small "fixes" not worth of mentioning.
